name: OBS: now playing
author: Voltage
description: Shows the song you're playing in a text source in OBS, and can show one of your sources (an overlay) only while music plays. Talks to OBS's own obs-websocket server on this PC (OBS 28+: Tools > WebSocket Server Settings).

settings.label: obs-websocket password
settings.help: From OBS: Tools > WebSocket Server Settings > Show Connect Info. Leave empty if authentication is off.

settings.label: Text source
settings.help: The name of a Text (GDI+) source in OBS. Empty: don't set any text.

settings.label: Show this source while music plays
settings.help: A source in your current scene (e.g. a music overlay). Empty: none.
